items.text: Ideogram launched Ad Resizer, converting one uploaded design into campaign-ready assets for social, video and connected-TV placements.
items.text_zh: Ideogram 推出 Ad Resizer，可将一份上传的设计转换成适配社交媒体、视频和联网电视广告位的整套素材。

items.text: Runway added Seedance 2.5, supporting 50 character references and music-synchronized video clips lasting up to 30 seconds.
items.text_zh: Runway 上线 Seedance 2.5，支持最多 50 个角色参考，并可生成最长 30 秒、与音乐同步的视频片段。

items.text: Luma introduced Scenes, letting creators refine individual scenes without regenerating an entire AI-produced advertisement.
items.text_zh: Luma 推出 Scenes，创作者可以单独调整某个场景，无需重新生成整支 AI 广告。

items.text: Krea launched a Slack beta combining multiple generative models with an agent that adapts to a creative team’s preferences.
items.text_zh: Krea 推出 Slack 测试版，将多款生成模型与能够适应创意团队偏好的智能体结合起来。

items.text: Replit expanded its MCP beta so external agents can create, load, search and publish Replit applications directly.
items.text_zh: Replit 扩展 MCP 测试版，外部智能体现在可以直接创建、载入、搜索并发布 Replit 应用。

items.text: Unsloth released an open-source desktop application for running and training models locally across macOS, Windows and Linux.
items.text_zh: Unsloth 发布开源桌面应用，支持在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 设备上本地运行及训练模型。

items.text: ElectricSQL, creator of browser-embeddable Postgres engine PGlite, is joining Databricks to bring WASM Postgres into AI-agent sandboxes.
items.text_zh: 浏览器内嵌式 Postgres 引擎 PGlite 的开发商 ElectricSQL 将加入 Databricks，把 WASM Postgres 引入 AI 智能体沙箱。

items.text: LlamaIndex introduced ExtractBench, a benchmark for measuring information extraction from complex enterprise documents.
items.text_zh: LlamaIndex 推出 ExtractBench，用于衡量模型从复杂企业文档中提取信息的能力。

items.text: Artificial Analysis found GPT-5.5 xhigh led its new AnalystAgent benchmark in single-run reliability with a 66% pass rate.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 的新 AnalystAgent 基准显示，GPT-5.5 xhigh 以 66% 的单次运行通过率取得最高可靠性。

items.text: Google demonstrated AMIE conducting real-time audio-visual clinical consultations in a first-of-its-kind research study.
items.text_zh: 谷歌在一项首创研究中展示了 AMIE 实时开展音视频临床问诊的能力。

items.text: General Catalyst led a $1.1 billion funding round for River AI, a startup founded only two months earlier.
items.text_zh: General Catalyst 领投 River AI 的 11 亿美元融资，而这家 AI 初创公司成立仅两个月。

items.text: OpenAI released a Linux preview of its ChatGPT desktop app, bringing ChatGPT Work and Codex to several major distributions.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Linux 桌面应用预览版，将 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 带到多个主流发行版。

items.text: Spotify will label AI Persona artist profiles and exclude their tracks from algorithmic recommendations, while leaving them searchable.
items.text_zh: Spotify 将标记“AI Persona”艺人主页，并把其音乐排除在算法推荐之外，但用户仍可主动搜索。

items.text: Manus said it will resume operating independently and announced transition measures required by regulations in specified regions.
items.text_zh: Manus 宣布将恢复独立运营，并将依据特定地区的监管要求实施相应过渡措施。
